profiles.title: Research Assistant - Monash University
profiles.description:
Full time. Dec 2025 - May 2026
Research Assistant at the Exertion Games Lab, Monash University, Australia. Contributed to multiple projects in the lab- human-food interaction, Radarfoot, Vibrobits, and kids bodily extensions. Coauthored paper at ACM CHI 2026.

profiles.title: Intern - SLT Mobitel
profiles.description:
Full time. Oct 2023 - Jan 2024
Engineering Intern at SLT Mobitel, Network Planning and Operations Division. Worked on network optimization projects and embedded systems, including realtime license plate recognition system with computer vision.

profiles.title: Intern - World Wildlife Fund (WWF)
profiles.description:
Part time. Mar 2023 - Mar 2025
Intern at WWF, Environmental and Disaster Management Division, under supervision of Dr. Missaka Hettiarachchi. Working on Augmented Reality mobile app for nature-based flood management method demonstration.

profiles.title: 👨‍🎓 Undergraduate
profiles.description: I'm currently an undergraduate student in Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering at the University of Moratuwa, with a strong academic record (CGPA: 3.94/4.00) and a passion for engineering research. I actively contribute to both academic and extracurricular work from hands-on electronics projects to leadership roles in clubs and societies. I serve as the head of web in Electronics Club and was the president of the Mathematics Society.

profiles.title: 🏫 School Journey
profiles.description: My foundation was laid at Visakha Vidyalaya, where I first developed a deep interest in both science and the arts. I was actively involved in prefects guilds, school band, hockey and montaineering teams, and societies. I served as the School Head Prefect and graduated with a strong academic and leadership record.

profiles.title: 🎵 Music
profiles.description: Music has always been a big part of my life. As an instrumentalist, I've found a second voice through music. I play the clarinet in the Colombo Wind Orchestra and the Junior Symphony Orchestra, and I regularly perform for university events. My musical talents extend to the piano, drums, and violin, and I've also composed a few original pieces as I explore music. Music has been not just a passion but a way to express creativity and build community through performance.

profiles.title: 🏑 Hockey
profiles.description: Playing as an attacker in my school and university hockey teams taught me teamwork, discipline, and resilience under pressure. I'm a proud representative of the Sri Lanka Universities Hockey Team, having competed at the Junior National Hockey Championship in both 2023 and 2024. I also played for the University of Moratuwa at the Sri Lanka University Games and Inter-University Games, earning University Colors in 2023, 2024, and 2025, for my performance and commitment to the sport.

bio:
Hello, I am Nilakna. I love electronics, physics, and simply, creating things. This is why I like doing engineering research, as it brings two of my favorite things together: electronics and creativity. I like working in collaborative research teams, and I've been fortunate to work with some amazing researchers.

I also love music and sports. I play the clarinet in local orchestras and played for my university hockey team. I believe this diverse set of interests has helped me develop a unique thinking pattern. What I want to do is to be a researcher to help advance human knowledge through cutting-edge technologies.
